_trn_tooltip.rtp_not_valid: The runtime path is not valid. Either the path is not a folder or it's not an empty directory
_trn_tooltip.rtp_incomplete_migration: This folder holds an unfinished move. Delete it or pick another empty folder.
_trn_tooltip.rtp_other_incomplete_migrat: This folder holds a move that did not finish, maybe from an older version. If you never used it as your data folder, delete it or pick another empty folder. If you did, delete the hidden .gdl_migration_in_progress file inside it (in Finder press Cmd+Shift+. to show hidden files; in Linux file managers press Ctrl+H), then pick it again.
_trn_tooltip.rtp_not_absolute: Enter the full path of a folder, or pick one with the folder icon.
_trn_tooltip.rtp_network_path: Network paths (starting with \\) can't be used. Map the network share to a drive letter in File Explorer, then pick the folder through that drive.
_trn_tooltip.rtp_drive_root: You can't use the root of a drive. Pick or create a folder on it instead, for example GDLauncher.
_trn_tooltip.rtp_nested: This folder is inside your current data folder, or contains it. Pick a folder outside it.
_trn_tooltip.rtp_install_overlap: This folder is part of GDLauncher's installation, which updates replace. Pick a folder outside it, for example in your user folder.
_trn_tooltip.rtp_system_dir: This is a system folder. Pick a folder in your user folder or on another drive.
_trn_tooltip.rtp_not_mounted: This drive is not mounted. Connect it and open it in your file manager, then pick the folder again.
_trn_tooltip.rtp_not_a_folder: This is not a folder: it is a file, or a link to something that no longer exists. Pick a folder.
_trn_tooltip.rtp_not_writable: GDLauncher can't write to this folder. Pick a folder you own, or allow writing to it.
